package.description: Free viewer for Wi-Spy spectrum analyzers

en-US.description: Free viewer for Wi-Spy spectrum analyzers
en-US.longDescription: With easy-to-use presets for the 2.4, 5 or 6 GHz bands used by Wi-Fi 7, Chanalyzer Lite makes it a snap to spot interference from Wi-Fi and non-Wi-Fi transmitters. Get a realtime look at transmitters with the Density View. See how transmissions change over time with the Waterfall View. Highlight signals of interest with configurable Markers. Chanalyzer Lite is a free download for Windows or Mac, and supports Wi-Spy Lucid and WiPry spectrum analyzer devices.
en-US.name: Chanalyzer Lite

zh-CN.description: Wi-Spy 频谱分析仪免费查看器
zh-CN.longDescription: Chanalyzer Lite 为 Wi-Fi 7 常用的 2.4、5 或 6 GHz 频段提供易用的预设，可快速发现 Wi-Fi 与非 Wi-Fi 发射器的干扰。Density View 可实时查看发射器，Waterfall View 可观察信号随时间的变化，还可通过可配置的标记突出感兴趣的信号。Chanalyzer Lite 支持 Windows 和 Mac，并兼容 Wi-Spy Lucid 与 WiPry 频谱分析仪设备。
